sloka: अभिद्रुतमिवारण्ये सिंहेन गजयूथपम् ।प्रच्छाद्यमानं रामेण भरतं त्रातुमर्हसि ॥२-८-३६॥
transliteration: abhidrutamivāraṇye siṁhena gajayūthapam ।pracchādyamānaṁ rāmeṇa bharataṁ trātumarhasi ॥2-8-36॥

translations.english: Like the leader of an elephantherd attacked by a lion in the forest, Bharata is going to be oppressed by Rama. You should save him.
